card.name: Units in table column headers
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or first letter of a unit in a table column header, such as (mL/min) after Creatinine Clearance or (mg) after Dose. Also the word 'in' before a unit and the 0 in 10^6 counts.

modes.label: Unit bracket in header
modes.description: The opening bracket or first letter of a unit right after a column title such as Dose or Infusion Rate.
modes.example: recommended infusion rate can be obtained from the following table: Creatinine Clearance (mL/min/1.73 m 2 ) Infusion Rate<< (>>mcg/kg/min) 5

modes.label: Clearance units
modes.description: The start of mL/min after Creatinine Clearance, or 'in' before it in a formula.
modes.example: 42 days for SAB and 5 days to 14 days for ABSSSI and CABP. Creatinine Clearance, CL CR (<<m>>L/min) Based on calculated creatinine

modes.label: Blood count powers of ten
modes.description: The 0 in 10 before a superscript in cell count units.
